nodes.name: worker.rs
nodes.summary: Background tokio worker that drains the sync outbox on three independent timers (push every 30s, merge every 30s, pull every 5min, plus a tail-end GC sweep), spawned once at app boot and living for the process lifetime.
nodes.languageNotes: Declares worker::{bulk_import,merge,merge_helpers,pull,push} as child modules via `mod` (not `use`), so the cross-file call relationships to those cycle functions aren't visible as static imports.

nodes.name: bulk_import.rs
nodes.summary: Drives every import_progress row in pending/running state forward by up to max_pages_per_project pages per tick, walking the adapter's paginated history import and recording metrics for each page outcome.

nodes.name: merge.rs
nodes.summary: Merge cycle: claims one merge_external outbox row at a time, runs the conflict resolver against local revision watermarks, and applies inbound creates/updates/deletes (including remote catalog/label/member backfill) to the local work item store.

nodes.name: merge_helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Helper functions that translate a conflict resolver's adopted-fields decision into a WorkItemPartialUpdate, mapping typed field-map entries to the local work item field names the write surface understands.

nodes.name: pull.rs
nodes.summary: Pull cycle: for every project with an attached adapter, fetches external changes since the last cursor (skipping projects with a recent webhook), appends merge_external outbox rows per change, and advances the sync cursor.

nodes.name: push.rs
nodes.summary: Push cycle: drains up to max_pushes pending outbox rows, dispatches each to its bound SyncAdapter, and persists success or failure-with-backoff, emitting one sync-status event per processed entry.

nodes.name: LoopConfig
nodes.summary: Tunable intervals and per-tick caps for the worker's push/pull/merge/import cycles.

nodes.name: start_worker
nodes.summary: Initializes the event emitter, recovers orphaned in-flight rows, and spawns the singleton worker loop on the Tauri async runtime.

nodes.name: recover_in_flight_orphans
nodes.summary: On startup, resets any rows stuck in_flight from an unclean shutdown back to pending.

nodes.name: run_loop
nodes.summary: The worker's main tokio loop: runs the push cycle plus GC every tick, and the merge/pull/import cycles on their own longer intervals.

nodes.name: gc_cycle
nodes.summary: Tail-end garbage collection of succeeded outbox rows older than the retention window, run once per push tick.

nodes.name: finalize_success
nodes.summary: Marks an outbox row succeeded after a push/merge attempt.

nodes.name: finalize_failure
nodes.summary: Marks an outbox row failed, applying backoff or immediate abandonment for non-retryable errors.

nodes.name: now_ms
nodes.summary: Returns the current time in epoch milliseconds.

nodes.name: now_ms_pub
nodes.summary: Public wrapper around now_ms for use by sibling worker submodules.

nodes.name: ImportPageOutcome
nodes.summary: Outcome of fetching one import page: Advanced, Completed, or Stopped.

nodes.name: import_cycle
nodes.summary: Drives every runnable import_progress row forward by up to max_pages_per_project pages, skipping/failing rows whose adapter doesn't support import.

nodes.name: import_one_page
nodes.summary: Fetches and applies a single import page for one project/adapter: calls the adapter, upserts imported rows as local outbox creates, advances the cursor, and records a metric for the page outcome.

nodes.name: merge_cycle
nodes.summary: Processes up to max_merges pending merge_external outbox rows, emitting a sync-status event per processed entry.

nodes.name: claim_one_merge
nodes.summary: Atomically claims one merge_external outbox row.

nodes.name: process_merge_entry
nodes.summary: Processes one merge entry and finalizes it as succeeded or failed-with-backoff.

nodes.name: process_merge_entry_inner
nodes.summary: Core merge logic: routes a merge_external entry to inbound-create, remote-delete, or field-conflict-resolution handling based on the local item's binding state and the resolver's decision.

nodes.name: apply_inbound_create
nodes.summary: Creates a local work item from an unbound external change, backfilling revision watermarks so future conflict resolution treats the fields as remote-authored.

nodes.name: apply_remote_delete
nodes.summary: Deletes the local work item corresponding to a remote delete change, when one is bound.

nodes.name: build_creator_backfill_update
nodes.summary: Builds a partial update that stamps the local item with the creator/assignee identity inferred from the inbound remote fields.

nodes.name: build_inbound_create_frontmatter
nodes.summary: Builds the WorkItemFrontmatter for a brand-new local item created from an inbound remote change.

nodes.name: upsert_remote_labels
nodes.summary: Upserts labels referenced by an inbound remote change into the project's local label catalog.

nodes.name: upsert_remote_members
nodes.summary: Upserts members referenced by an inbound remote change into the project's local member catalog.

nodes.name: build_inbound_create_revisions
nodes.summary: Builds the per-field revision-watermark stamps for a freshly created local item so later local edits are correctly recognized as newer than the remote import.

nodes.name: build_partial_update
nodes.summary: Translates a resolver decision's adopted fields into a WorkItemPartialUpdate.

nodes.name: partial_update_from_map
nodes.summary: Builds a WorkItemPartialUpdate from a plain field-name-to-value map.

nodes.name: partial_update_from_iter
nodes.summary: Core field-mapping loop: matches each local field name to its WorkItemPartialUpdate slot; unknown field names are silently dropped as not yet writable.

nodes.name: local_values_for_field_map
nodes.summary: Reads the local values for every field declared in a FieldMap so the resolver can compare them against inbound remote values.

nodes.name: pull_cycle
nodes.summary: For every project with an attached adapter, fetches external changes since the last cursor and queues them for the merge cycle, skipping projects with a recent webhook delivery.

nodes.name: pull_one_project_by_slug
nodes.summary: Looks up a project's binding by slug and runs one pull for it; used by the manual force-pull command.

nodes.name: pull_one_project_inner
nodes.summary: Fetches external changes for one project from its adapter, appends merge_external outbox rows, advances the cursor, and records pull metrics.

nodes.name: push_cycle
nodes.summary: Drains up to max_pushes pending outbox rows, dispatching each to process_entry.

nodes.name: process_entry
nodes.summary: Processes one outbox entry and finalizes it as succeeded or failed-with-backoff.

nodes.name: process_entry_inner
nodes.summary: Dispatches one outbox entry to its bound SyncAdapter's push method, emits a status event, and records a push metric.
